title: LocAgent: Graph-Guided LLM Agents for Code Localization

prompt.location: Sec 5.3/Appendix C.1; relies on the public, established agent-framework prompts (Agentless, SWE-agent, MoatlessTools, OpenHands), not reprinted verbatim in this paper

notes: GPT-4o is run as the backbone LLM inside four different open-source agent scaffolds (Agentless, MoatlessTools, SWE-agent, OpenHands) that LocAgent's authors configured themselves for a controlled comparison; LocAgent's own novel model uses fine-tuned Qwen2.5, not a live-listed OpenAI model. Cost is high because SWE-bench Lite agent rollouts involve many tool-call turns per instance.
